notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.content:
Hey, everybody! 

Update 1.2 is out now and it brings a lot of changes to the game, such as:

-Gamepad control, now the game can be fully completed from start to finish on any gamepad

-Fixed the display of dialog text, now the texts have a fixed size and will not change dynamically

-Fixed minor bugs that you may not have noticed :)

The update has affected the demo version as well, so if you haven't purchased Life of Slime yet, please try out the demo version.
